message:
CHANGES.md: massage ASN1_STRING_set1_*() entry

The observed absence of an out-of-bounds NUL terminator is a result
of behaviour of a previous setter, mentione that expressely. Also, move
the entry to the additions sections and perform a minor formatting cleanup.
